title: Foundation 4: define capability evidence categories and their exact claims
description:
Successor concept work for the evidence half of eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1 (PR #477,
DESIGN_INVALIDATED). Blocked on Foundations 1 and 3.

PREMISE CHANGE (why this exists): PRs #475/#476/#477 reached DESIGN_INVALIDATED
after repeatedly producing NEW defect classes following material contract changes
and fresh full reviews. The shared root cause was not implementation quality: in
all three, unsettled concepts were GENERALIZED ACROSS THE CORPUS before their
trust boundaries had been proven by a small number of concrete
source-to-execution examples. Successor work inverts that order.

GOAL: define evidence categories and, for EACH, state exactly what it proves AND
what it explicitly does NOT prove. #477 failed repeatedly because evidence types
claimed more than they established — exported-symbol presence presented as
capability evidence, bead existence presented as contract ownership, absence of
an invented marker presented as semantic absence.

CATEGORIES TO DISTINGUISH AT MINIMUM:
  source obligation | audit finding | current pack projection | readiness
  artifact | code symbol presence | code-path reachability | executable
  provider-neutral capability | pack-driven reference execution | bead ownership
  | ownership contract verification | known missing projection | positive
  absence proof.

REQUIRED PRINCIPLE, learned the hard way across five fail-open defects in this
program: an evaluation path that cannot resolve its input must FAIL, never
return an empty failure list. "No failures found" must never be representable as
"all checks passed". Positive absence must be POSITIVELY established, never
inferred from a missing invented marker, and unclassified structured material
must remain underived rather than silently satisfying.

SALVAGE from #477 (design input): the evidence-strength vocabulary, and the
identification of primitives invisible from current pack projection.
REPLACE: invented sentinel-absence evidence; exported-symbol existence as
capability evidence; bead-existence as exact contract ownership; any resolver
claiming more than its evidence proves.
acceptance_criteria:
• Every evidence category states what it proves and what it explicitly does not prove.
• No category permits presence, ownership or candidacy to stand for semantic implementation.
• Positive absence is defined as a positive proof obligation, never inference from a missing marker.
• Unresolvable input fails closed; an empty failure list can never mean satisfied.
